name: MKX | 200mg Gummies | Deep Sleep Canna Mango
description: A sweet treat that promises relaxation like no other. 200mg THC + 50mg CBN per bag. We took our top-selling THC gummy recipe and enhanced it with CBN in a 4:1 ratio to aid you in getting the rest you deserve. CBN is a cannabinoid that has been found to help with insomnia, and even treating inflammatory diseases. Available in four different flavors, come and experience the reason we put Patients over Profits.
